lines.text: A prophet's sign comes true but he urges other gods, so Israel must not listen; the LORD is testing them.
Israel must hold fast to the LORD, and that prophet must die for urging rebellion against the God of Babylon.
If a brother, son, daughter, wife or closest friend secretly entices them toward other gods, they must show no pity.
Israel must stone the one who enticed them, and then all Israel will hear and be proud.
If a city's sin is certain after investigation, it must be burned with its plunder and never rebuilt.
